description: This file contains utility functions for handling differences and formatting values related to altered slices in a Superset frontend component. It includes functions for normalizing comparison values, formatting diff data, and generating row representations from diffs.

methods.name: alterForComparison
methods.description: Normalizes a value for comparison by treating null, undefined, empty strings, empty arrays, and empty objects as null.

methods.name: formatValueHandler
methods.description: Formats a diff item value into a string or number based on its type and control map, handling special cases for filters, bounds, collections, and metrics.

methods.name: getRowsFromDiffs
methods.description: Generates an array of row objects from a diffs object and control map, formatting before and after values.
